1  ---
 2  name: runway-analysis
 3  description: Decide whether a runway is long enough for a given aircraft at a given field elevation. Use when the user asks about runway suitability, takeoff or landing distance, or operating out of a high-elevation field.
 4  license: MIT
 5  ---
 6  
 7  # Runway Analysis
 8  
 9  ## When to use
10  
11  The user is asking whether an aircraft can safely operate from a specific
12  runway, or is comparing two airports for a trip.
13  
14  ## Procedure
15  
16  1. Get the field elevation and the longest runway length with
17     `lookup_field_elevation` and `lookup_runway_length`.
18  2. Read `/skills/runway-analysis/reference/margins.md` for the required margin
19     table. Do not work from memory — the table is the authority.
20  3. Compare the runway length against the required distance for the aircraft
21     class at that elevation.
22  4. State the verdict in one sentence, then give the two numbers you compared.
23  
24  ## Reporting
25  
26  Always name the margin you applied. A verdict without the margin is not
27  reviewable.
